slides.texte_overlay:
soft habits that made me
feel so much more feminine

slowing everything down

i started walking, pouring tea and turning pages a little slower. that unhurried pace gives you a soft, graceful presence that people notice the moment you enter.

a calmer voice

i lowered my voice and stopped rushing my sentences. people lean in to listen when your energy is calm, and conversations start to feel so much gentler and warmer.

beautiful stories to share

i always have a lovely myth or fact ready, and it makes me feel elegant in any conversation. having something beautiful to share feels like the softest kind of confidence.
slides.texte_sophia:
beautiful stories to share

i always have a lovely story ready now. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a painting, and sharing it makes me feel so elegant and interesting.

slides.texte_overlay:
protecting my peace

i stopped joining every drama and argument around me. choosing calm over chaos, again and again, has made me feel softer, lighter and far more like myself.

little rituals

i turned boring chores into tiny rituals with candles, music and pretty cups. it makes ordinary days feel gentle and makes me feel like the main character of my own life.
